regulatory_history.title: United States v. InMobi Pte Ltd. (N.D. Cal. No. 3:16-cv-03474): stipulated order
regulatory_history.body: US District Court for the Northern District of California, in a case brought by the United States for the US Federal Trade Commission
regulatory_history.notes: Complaint filed 2016-06-22 against InMobi Pte Ltd., whose business has since been transferred into InMobi Technology Services Private Limited. The order permanently bars collecting or inferring location without consent and requires a privacy program, with assessments every two years for 20 years. InMobi neither admitted nor denied the charges.

regulatory_history.title: Caldwell v. InMobi Technology Services Private Limited (N.D. Cal. No. 25-cv-09977)
regulatory_history.body: US District Court for the Northern District of California
regulatory_history.notes: Removed to federal court on 2025-11-19. Claims under the California Invasion of Privacy Act's pen register provision, intrusion upon seclusion and the California Constitution, over data InMobi's SDK collected from a dating app. The court denied InMobi's motion to dismiss on 2026-04-29; InMobi answered on 2026-05-13, denying the allegations except as admitted.
